payload.summary: Ownership contract: owns PRD F2 row reconstruction and F6 current-state/incomplete/repair behavior. Reconstruct exactly one candidate per resolved ticket from current durable tickets, resolution events, decision observations, maps/nodes, and source events on every invocation; exclude all closure dispositions; survive distillation/archive; retain only proved facts when joins fail; repair upgrades the same ticket row and removes incomplete without duplicates. Focused acceptance stays here: ticket types and closures, distillation/archive, each missing-join boundary, mixed healthy/incomplete rows, and two-pass repair with --provenance incomplete before/after. Rendering layout/zoom belongs to t71vpsjs; ordering/filter parsing belongs to dnj87rfb.
